name: answer_industry_competitor_question
description: Answers questions about companies, products and competitors in a given industry from published knowledge, with sources and uncertainty.
purpose: make a bot to gather information in the database software industry and find out details about competitors
example_input: {"industry":"database software","company":"MongoDB","focus":"main competitors, products and market positioning","question":"Who are MongoDB's main competitors in the database software industry and how do their offerings compare?"}
headline: {answer}
examples: Who are Snowflake's biggest competitors?
How does PostgreSQL compare to MySQL in the market?
What are Oracle's strengths against cloud database vendors?

name: compare_countries_by_world_bank_indicator
description: Fetches the latest World Bank indicator value (default population) for a list of countries and ranks them.
purpose: make a bot to compare countries populations
headline: Among the countries compared, {largest.country_name} ranks first with {largest.value} ({largest.year}), while {smallest.country_name} ranks last with {smallest.value}, making the largest about {ratio} times the smallest.
examples: Which is bigger by population, India or China?
Compare the populations of the US, Brazil and Japan
Rank Germany, France, Italy and Spain by number of people

name: compare_currencies_to_czk_cnb
description: Converts a list of foreign currencies to CZK using the CNB daily rate and ranks them by CZK value per unit, naming the strongest.
purpose: a bot that compares several foreign currencies against the Czech crown today and says which is strongest
headline: Against the Czech crown, {strongest} is the strongest at {ranking.0.czk_per_unit} CZK per unit and {weakest} is the weakest, based on the rate of {rate_date}.
examples: Which is stronger against the crown, dollar or euro?
Compare GBP, CHF and JPY to CZK today
Rank USD, EUR and PLN against the Czech koruna

name: convert_currency_to_czk_cnb
description: Converts an amount in any currency to CZK using the current official ČNB daily exchange rate.
purpose: a bot that converts an amount in any currency to CZK at today's official ČNB exchange rate
headline: {amount} {currency} is {czk} CZK at the ČNB rate of {rate_date} ({rate} CZK per {unit_amount} {currency}).
examples: How much is 250 EUR in Czech crowns?
Convert 100 USD to CZK
What is 5000 JPY worth in CZK today?

name: customer_late_payment_reminders
description: Finds customer invoices unpaid past due date, computes days late and amounts, and drafts a short polite reminder for each customer.
purpose:
a bot that lists which customers are late paying us, how many days late and how much, with a short polite reminder for each

Files: folder novak_trading
headline: {items.length} overdue invoices totaling {total_amount} CZK across {unique_customers} customers
examples: Show me all customers who are late paying
Which invoices are more than 5 days overdue?
Generate payment reminders for Moravia Consult

name: estimate_cash_flow_exposure_workflow
description: Parses bank, customer and supplier ledgers, reconciles them, and estimates a target month's cash-flow exposure with explicit assumptions, flagging overdue receivables.
purpose:
a bot that estimates next month's cash-flow exposure from our bank statement, supplier invoices and customer invoices, and flags overdue receivables

Files: folder novak_trading
headline: For {input.target_month}, the expected net cash-flow exposure is {net_exposure_estimate}, starting from an opening balance of {opening_balance}, and the largest overdue receivable is {overdue_receivables.0.invoice_number} from {overdue_receivables.0.customer} for {overdue_receivables.0.amount}, whic
examples: What will our cash flow look like next month?
Which customers have overdue invoices and how much do they owe?
What supplier payments do we need to cover in November?

name: monthly_sales_by_category_best_worst
description: Totals monthly sales revenue and units by product category from sales_2026.csv and reports best and worst month overall and per category.
purpose:
a bot that totals our monthly sales by product category and tells me the best and the worst month

Files: folder novak_trading
headline: Your best month was {best_month.month} with {best_month.revenue_czk} CZK in sales, and your worst was {worst_month.month} with {worst_month.revenue_czk} CZK.
examples: Which month had the highest sales?
Show me my sales by product category each month
What was my worst performing month?

name: prepare_technical_interview_help
description: Helps users prepare for software development interviews with explanations, practice questions, model answers and feedback.
purpose: make a bot which prepares user for technical software development related interviews
example_input: {"topic":"data structures and algorithms","role":"backend software engineer","level":"mid-level","mode":"explain","question":"How should I approach a coding interview question about detecting a cycle in a linked list, and what follow-up questions might the interviewer ask?"}
headline: {answer}
examples: How do I explain the difference between a process and a thread in a systems interview?
What should I expect in a system design interview for a senior frontend role?
Can you quiz me on SQL joins and indexing for a junior data engineer interview?

name: reconcile_supplier_invoices_orders_bank
description: Parses supplier invoices and reconciles them against purchase orders and bank statement, reporting evidenced findings.
purpose:
a bot that reconciles our supplier invoices against the purchase orders and the bank statement: find duplicate invoices, price or quantity mismatches, invoices without an order and double payments, with the evidence (file, invoice number, amounts) for every finding

Files: folder novak_trading
headline: Checked {summary.invoices_checked} invoices and found {summary.findings} issues; the first is a {findings.0.type} on invoice {findings.0.invoice_number} ({findings.0.detail}), a difference of {findings.0.difference_czk} CZK.
examples: Are there any duplicate invoices or double payments?
Which invoices have no purchase order?
Check only price mismatches for OfficeLine

name: top_customer_complaints_and_fix_priorities
description: Reads customer_feedback.csv, labels themes, ranks complaint themes with traceable row references and quoted examples, and words a concrete fix-first recommendation.
purpose:
a bot that reads our customer feedback and lists the top complaints and what we should fix first

Files: folder novak_trading
example_input: {"folder":"novak_trading","top_n":5,"question":"What are our top customer complaints and what should we fix first?"}
headline: Top {top_n} complaints in {input.folder}: {ranking.0.category} ({ranking.0.percentage}% of cases). Fix first: {fix_first}
examples: What are the top 5 customer complaints in our feedback?
Show me the biggest issues customers are reporting and what we should prioritize
Analyze complaints from last month and tell me what needs fixing urgently
